The combination and sequence are substantially more distinctive than generic diplomatic courtesy. C17 and C21 share ceremonial language about aspirations, friendship, liberty, and justice, but lack C01's closer structural machinery involving technology and a personal emissary.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"It gives me great pleasure to express to Your Majesty the good wishes of the people of the United States, together with my own, on the occasion of the opening of the Brussels Universal and International Exhibition","parent_excerpt":"It is a pleasure to send you greetings through General Curtis LeMay on the occasion of Argentina's Aviation Week.","explanation":"Both open by sending presidential and national greetings to a foreign leader on the occasion of a major national exhibition or celebration."},{"child_excerpt":"The theme for the Exhibition announced by your Commissioner General-how scientific advances are being used to realize man's brightest and highest aspirations","parent_excerpt":"General LeMay's flight is a graphic demonstration of how rapidly technology is reducing the once formidable barriers of time and distance in communication between countries.","explanation":"Both use the ceremonial event as a platform for discussing scientific or technological advances and their beneficial international implications."},{"child_excerpt":"I have asked my good friend and associate, Mr. Leonard W. Hall, to call upon Your Majesty as my personal representative and to convey to you my salutations and congratulations.","parent_excerpt":"I have asked General LeMay to convey to your Government and the Argentine people the greetings of the people and Government of the United States, and to you my personal best wishes.","explanation":"This is closely parallel administrative and diplomatic machinery: a named envoy is instructed to personally transmit greetings and good wishes."},{"child_excerpt":"a powerful force toward peace, freedom, and justice for all mankind","parent_excerpt":"international cooperation dedicated to the achievement of peace and justice","explanation":"Both conclude their treatment of technological progress and international contact by linking it to peace and justice."}]}
